benefits.name: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen carry-on and checked baggage while traveling on a common carrier when the full fare is charged to the card.
benefits.terms: Up to $1,250 for carry-on baggage, up to $500 for checked baggage.

benefits.name: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: 24/7 medical, legal, financial, or other select emergency coordination and assistance while traveling more than 100 miles from home.
benefits.terms: Assistance/referral service; cardholder is responsible for the cost of any third-party services rendered.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss & Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft of most rental vehicles.
benefits.terms: Up to $50,000 in coverage. Secondary coverage (not primary). Requires reserving and paying for the entire rental with this card and declining the rental company's collision damage waiver.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible items against accidental damage or theft for 90 days from purchase.
benefits.terms: Up to $1,000 per claim, up to $50,000 per calendar year.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 5 years or less by an additional year.

earningRates.terms: Flights and prepaid hotels booked on AmexTravel.com.
